def to_html(text):
    # Split text into blocks separated by blank lines
    blocks = text.split('\n\n')
    
    # Process each block
    processed_blocks = []
    for block in blocks:
        if block.strip():  # Only process non-empty blocks
            # Join lines within block with single spaces
            lines = block.split('\n')
            joined_line = ' '.join(lines)
            # Escape special characters
            escaped_line = joined_line.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')
            processed_blocks.append(escaped_line)
    
    # Join blocks with "\n"
    return '\n'.join(processed_blocks)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test cases
    assert to_html("Hello\nWorld") == "Hello World"
    assert to_html("Hello\n\nWorld") == "Hello\nWorld"
    assert to_html("Hello\n&\nWorld") == "Hello & World"
    assert to_html("Hello\n<\nWorld") == "Hello < World"
    assert to_html("Hello\n>\nWorld") == "Hello > World"
    assert to_html("Hello\n&\nWorld\n\nFoo\nBar") == "Hello & World\nFoo Bar"
    print("All tests passed!")
